issue_request: FHIR-6123 asked to change the standard _id search parameter from token to string because Resource.id has datatype id. The final Published/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution instead required the specification to document specifically how token is used for _id and related searches.
initial_application: No current git commit was found that mentions FHIR-6123 directly. The closest historical application is 2c8afef000 (#9717), which changed the search summary table from string to token and documented exact no-system token behavior for _id. Later refactoring in ddecc63591 moved and expanded the explanation into the current dedicated _id section.
additional_context: The active Resource search parameter source defines Resource-_id as token over Resource.id, and source/fhir.ini maps datatype id to token in search rules. The related Published FHIR-13320 case-sensitivity issue and a later implementer Zulip thread confirm that _id uses token search-parameter semantics, exact matching, and case-sensitive behavior despite the underlying id datatype.
